about.whoAmIText: Mid-Level Full-Stack Developer with a strong interest in Clean Architecture and exploring modern software technologies. Experienced in building scalable web applications, designing RESTful APIs, integrating AI background workflows, and managing cloud storage infrastructure. Passionate about continuous learning and writing maintainable, structured code.
about.whatIDoText: I build full-stack web applications with a focus on clean, testable architecture. My work spans backend development with C# .NET Core and Laravel, modern frontends with Vue 3 and React, background job processing with Hangfire, and infrastructure such as Docker, MinIO and cloud object storage.

job1.title: Junior Developer
job1.description: Full-stack development and platform maintenance across key client products. Built backend APIs using C# .NET Core, developed Vue 3 UI components, integrated Hangfire background jobs, automated PDF/Excel generation and email services for an OCR-processing platform. Also updated frontend features on an HR platform and used AI-assisted workflows to migrate a client's mobile app from FlutterFlow to clean, native Flutter code.

job2.title: Data / AI Infrastructure Intern
job2.description: Built infrastructure and integration pipelines for AI initiatives, working independently. Managed Linux servers via SSH, deployed MinIO Object Storage to centralize team datasets, and configured environment architecture. Authored RESTful APIs to expose trained ML models to web applications, collaborating through Git.

job3.title: School Projects & Hands-on Practice
job3.description: Final-year project: a cloud-deployed vehicle rental platform. Also worked as Backend Developer for a team school magazine site — designing REST APIs in Laravel and managing media assets via AWS S3.
